headlines.title: 城堡证券：五大催化剂罕见共振，黄金正从反弹走向新一轮上攻阶段
headlines.summary: 城堡证券策略师斯Scott Rubner今年来首度看多黄金，建议投资人布局黄金结构性部位，称当前是数月来最具吸引力的贵金属上行机会之一。Rubner指出，贵金属过去一年被AI热潮边缘化，但今年1至2月行情已证明散户可迅速转为增量买盘，一旦趋势确认，资金回流将放大涨势。此外，在美国财政压力、美元信用讨论与地缘风险未消背景下，美联储转鸽、央行扫货、CTA空头回补、期权偏度逆转及散户回流五大因素罕见共振，黄金正从反弹走向新一轮上攻阶段，短期需紧盯美国8月CPI与美联储口风，但战略配置窗口已被打开。

headlines.title_en: Citadel Securities: Five catalysts rarely align, gold shifts from rebound to a new upward phase
headlines.summary_en: Citadel Securities strategist Scott Rubner turns bullish on gold for the first time this year, advising investors to build structural positions in the precious metal, calling it one of the most attractive upside opportunities in months. Rubner notes gold has been sidelined by the AI frenzy over the past year, but the January-February price action shows retail can quickly turn into incremental buyers—once the trend is confirmed, capital inflows will amplify the rally. With U.S. fiscal pressure, dollar credibility debates, and geopolitical risks persisting, five factors—a dovish Fed pivot, central bank buying, CTA short-covering, options skew reversal, and retail inflows—are unusually converging. Gold is transitioning from a rebound to a new leg of advance. Near-term focus is on August U.S. CPI and Fed signals, but the strategic allocation window has opened.

headlines.title_en: Wall Street Breakfast | August 11, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Tech stocks dragged U.S. equities, with the S&P 500 and Dow pulling back from record highs; Nvidia fell nearly 3%, while optical communications firm Coherent dropped over 10%. Chinese ADRs bucked the trend, with Alibaba up 3%. Crude rose over 5% intraday, European natural gas gained over 10%, the yen dipped 1% at one point, and offshore yuan stepped back from a three-year high. Trump demanded Iran pay reparations and be included in all future negotiations, claiming U.S. forces have '100% control' of the Strait of Hormuz. Iran underwent a flurry of leadership changes, with the Supreme Leader appointing six senior military commanders. U.S. strategic petroleum reserves fell below 300 million barrels for the first time since 1983. Trump denied frequent calls with Warsh, saying they have spoken only once since he took over. Reports suggest the BoJ's September rate-hike signal prompted U.S. involvement in FX intervention. South Korea announced a new 5 trillion won fund focused on semiconductor materials and components.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 澳洲联储料维持利率不变 但强调手中仍握着“大棒”
headlines.summary: 机构分析称，澳洲联储将于北京时间12:30公布政策会议结果，这很可能是一场“面面俱到”的沟通大师课。行长米歇尔·布洛克看起来大概率会宣布维持官方现金利率不变，但同时会警告——她手中仍握有大棒，未来利率仍可能上调。澳洲联储一方面会对近期通胀降温的迹象表示欢迎，另一方面也会对房价下跌的速度感到一定担忧。不过，抗击价格压力的战斗尚未取得胜利，而中东战事很可能轻易成为另一轮供给冲击的源头。

headlines.title_en: RBA expected to hold rates steady but stresses it still holds the 'big stick'
headlines.summary_en: Institutional analysis says the RBA will announce its policy decision at 12:30 Beijing time, likely a masterclass in nuanced communication. Governor Michele Bullock looks set to hold the cash rate steady while warning that she still holds a big stick—rates could still rise. The RBA will welcome recent signs of cooling inflation but also show some concern over the pace of home price declines. Still, the battle against price pressures is not won, and Middle East conflict could easily become another source of supply shocks.

headlines.title: 刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”
headlines.summary: 8月8日至10日，中共中央对外联络部部长刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”。其间，同古共中央第一书记、古巴国家主席迪亚斯-卡内尔，古共中央政治局委员、中央组织书记莫拉莱斯，古共中央国际关系部部长洛萨达等会见交流。双方表示，将共同落实好两党两国最高领导人达成的重要共识，赓续传统友谊，深化党际交往，加强战略沟通与协作，携手推进各自国家社会主义事业，为中古命运共同体建设作出更大贡献。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Liu Haixing leads CPC delegation to visit Cuba and attends the first 'Fidel International Dialogue'
headlines.summary_en: From August 8 to 10, Liu Haixing, head of the CPC Central Committee's International Department, led a CPC delegation to Cuba and attended the inaugural 'Fidel International Dialogue.' During the visit, he met with Cuba's First Secretary and President Miguel Díaz-Canel, Politburo member and Organization Secretary Roberto Morales, and International Relations Minister Emilio Lozada. Both sides pledged to implement the important consensus reached by top leaders of the two parties and states, carry forward traditional friendship, deepen inter-party exchanges, strengthen strategic communication and coordination, jointly advance socialist causes, and contribute more to building a China-Cuba community with a shared future. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 综合多重因素，赴港投保性价比被重新评估
headlines.summary: 近日调研获悉，受“香港保单收益征税”消息影响，一些消费者正重新评估赴港投保性价比。已有多位香港保险营销员接到客户咨询，他们明显感受到市场正在降温。此外，随着人民币汇率不断升值，赴港投保的预期收益有所降低。在业内人士看来，受税收、汇率等因素影响，短期内消费者赴港投保将会降温，尤其是投资型保险产品受影响更大。对于消费者而言，未来赴港投保应综合考虑产品、汇率、合规、服务等多方面因素。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Considering multiple factors, the value proposition of buying insurance in Hong Kong is being reassessed
headlines.summary_en: Recent reporting shows that due to news of 'tax on Hong Kong policy gains,' some consumers are reassessing the value of buying insurance in Hong Kong. Multiple Hong Kong insurance agents have received client inquiries and clearly sense the market cooling. Additionally, as the RMB appreciates, expected returns from Hong Kong policies have declined. Industry insiders say that in the short term, tax and FX factors will cool demand for Hong Kong insurance, especially investment-linked products. Consumers should weigh product, currency, compliance, and service factors comprehensively for future purchases. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中国商务部: 自巴西进口的牛肉已达到保障措施规定数量的90%
headlines.summary: 中国商务部公告称，牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉于2026年8月10日已达到商务部公告2025年第87号明确的该国家（地区）规定数量的90%。根据商务部公告2025年第87号，在牛肉进口数量达到规定数量100%的第3日起（含当日），将在现行适用关税税率基础上加征55%关税。

headlines.title_en: China's MOFCOM: Beef imports from Brazil have reached 90% of the volume specified under the safeguard measures
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced that beef imports from Brazil under the safeguard measure reached 90% of the specified volume for that country as defined in MOFCOM Announcement No. 87 of 2025, as of August 10, 2026. headlines.title: 金融产品网络营销新规9月底起实施，保险业提前摸排整治账号端乱象
headlines.summary: 金融产品网络营销最严监管规定——《金融产品网络营销管理办法》将于9月30日起实施。记者从相关渠道获悉，针对办法对保险机构网络营销划定的“硬杠杠”，监管部门正在主动摸排整治账号端乱象、厘清市场生态，为新规落地铺路。受访人士表示，随着监管部门整治深入和办法落地实施，“机构担责+人证合一+可回溯”将是保险网络营销的最终走向。从长期看，这有利于降低消费者的信任成本，激活真实保险需求，推动保险机构业务质量、续保率等长期指标提升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: New rules on online marketing of financial products take effect from end of September, insurance industry moves early to inspect and rectify account-side irregularities
headlines.summary_en: The strictest regulation on online marketing of financial products—the 'Measures for the Administration of Online Marketing of Financial Products'—takes effect September 30. Sources say regulators are proactively identifying and rectifying account-side irregularities and clarifying the market landscape to pave the way for the new rules. Respondents say that as regulatory scrutiny deepens and the measures are implemented, 'institution accountability + ID verification + traceability' will be the ultimate direction for insurance online marketing. Long term, this helps lower consumer trust costs, unlock real insurance demand, and improve long-term metrics like business quality and renewal rates. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 高塔姆·阿达尼赢得美国证券欺诈指控的驳回
headlines.summary: 美国纽约东区联邦地区法院法官Nicholas Garaufis驳回了对高塔姆·阿达尼及其侄子萨加尔·阿达尼的共谋、证券欺诈和电信欺诈指控。 美国方面指控阿达尼参与了一项向印度政府官员行贿超过2.5亿美元以锁定太阳能合同的计划——阿达尼始终否认这些指控。 该裁决标志着阿达尼在美国法律麻烦的终结，此前他还曾与美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和财政部达成和解。

headlines.title_en: Gautam Adani wins dismissal of US securities fraud charges
headlines.summary_en: A U.S. federal judge in the Eastern District of New York, Nicholas Garaufis, dismissed conspiracy, securities fraud, and wire fraud charges against Gautam Adani and his nephew Sagar Adani. U.S. authorities had accused Adani of being involved in a scheme to bribe Indian government officials with over $250 million to secure solar contracts—charges Adani has consistently denied. The ruling marks the end of Adani's legal troubles in the U.S., following earlier settlements with the SEC and the Treasury Department.

headlines.title: 煤炭工业五年规划发布！下半年煤炭板块普涨（附绩优股）
headlines.summary: 城堡证券策略师斯Scott Rubner今年来首度看多黄金，建议投资人布局黄金结构性部位，称当前是数月来最具吸引力的贵金属上行机会之一。Rubner指出，贵金属过去一年被AI热潮边缘化，但今年1至2月行情已证明散户可迅速转为增量买盘，一旦趋势确认，资金回流将放大涨势。此外，在美国财政压力、美元信用讨论与地缘风险未消背景下，美联储转鸽、央行扫货、CTA空头回补、期权偏度逆转及散户回流五大因素罕见共振，黄金正从反弹走向新一轮上攻阶段，短期需紧盯美国8月CPI与美联储口风，但战略配置窗口已被打开。
